title: Quickly Fermented Kenyan Meal Grill
description:
A flavorful, lacto-vegetarian Kenyan dish featuring fermented cabbage, sage, and bonito shave, grilled on a binchotan grill.
This meal-prep dish is perfect for a quick and easy lunch or dinner.
instructions: Shred the cabbage and soak it in a brine of 1/4 cup water and 1/4 cup yogurt for 30 minutes.
Grate the carrots and chop the onion, setting them aside.
Finely chop the sage and garlic.
Mix the bonito flakes and tomato paste in a bowl.
Add the olive oil, salt, and black pepper to the bowl and mix well.
Grill the cabbage mixture for 10 minutes on each side, or until it's tender and slightly charred.
Grill the carrot and onion mixture for 5 minutes on each side, or until it's tender and lightly browned.
Assemble the dish by placing the grilled cabbage and carrot mixture on a plate and topping it with the bonito mixture.
Serve the dish hot and enjoy!
Garnish with additional sage and bonito flakes if desired.
